name: Numeral Limited
summary: Headquartered in Phoenix, Mauritius, Numeral Limited operates as an investment holding entity with diverse interests across the biotech, health and pharmaceutical, and financial sectors within the country. The company also provides an extensive array of ancillary services, including legal support, human resources, technology assistance, financial consulting, corporate finance, marketing, and business acquisition solutions. Established in 2010, the firm adopted its current designation, Numeral Limited, in December 2023, having formerly been known as Go Life International Limited.
